hypotheses: (htau : ∀ H : SimpleGraph V, H ≤ G → H.CliqueFree 3 → ∃ f : V → C, IsProp' H f)
(hchi : ∀ f : V → (ℕ → C), ¬ IsProp' G f)
spec.proof:
by
  classical
  rintro ⟨H, hfree, hEq⟩
  have hle : ∀ i, H i ≤ G := by
    intro i; rw [hEq]; exact le_iSup H i
  choose f hf using fun i => htau (H i) (hle i) (hfree i)
  refine hchi (fun v => fun i => f i v) ?_
  rw [hEq]
  intro a b hab hcon
  rw [SimpleGraph.iSup_adj] at hab
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hab
  exact hf i a b hi (congrFun hcon i)
